dz: 得到安提洛克王子雷纳尔德(英语:Raynald of Châtillon)的呈文后,拜占庭皇帝曼努埃尔一世·科姆内诺斯(英语:Manuel I Komnenos)成功入驻安提洛克城.
de: Having received the submission of the prince of Antioch, Raynald of Châtillon, Byzantine Emperor Manuel I Komnenos enters triumphantly the city of Antioch.

de: Cardinal Rolando Bandinelli is elected Pope Alexander III, prompting the election of Cardinal Octaviano Monticelli as Antipope Victor IV the same day.
